text:
Mina (Sales): Lumen insists the POC must anchor EU traffic to EU and APAC to APAC, KMS keys in-region, and a per-region sub-processor inventory + short attestation. Can we do this for a two-week POC and what's the delta cost?

Raj (SE): Yes — tenant-level region anchoring is supported. Options: BYOK into cloud KMS or platform key scoped to region. We'll disable cross-region analytics/backups for the tenant by default. Need customer's definition of sensitive metadata (they mentioned IPs/headers).

Client_Lumen: IPs and full request headers are sensitive. Timeline: want to start Mon 2026-06-01. Need an API call to set anchoring and a small POC quote under $1.2k.

Alejandra (Infra): Ops steps: tenant routing entry, provision/import KMS key, create customer log sink in-region, disable replication and analytics exports. Estimate 12-24h if BYOK provided; HSM import + validation + escrow adds ~24-48h.

Tara (Legal): We'll need the per-region sub-processor list (EU, APAC) and confirmation that control-plane audit logs and billing metadata can be routed to the customer's bucket. Also will prepare attestation text once infra confirms.

Raj (SE): API snippet (curl): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/lumen/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"region":"europe-west1","kms_key":"projects/lumen/locations/europe-west1/keys/lm-key"}'
Query effective: curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/lumen/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"

Alejandra (Infra): We can route audit + billing events to their EU bucket for the POC. Sub-processors (summary): cloud provider compute/networking, managed KMS, metrics agent, backup service. DMing full inventory to legal (sensitive).

Tara (Legal): Draft attestation (placeholder): "For the 14-day POC, Redwood will route tenant traffic and keep KMS keys, backups, and audit logs within the tenant's pinned region; no PII-bearing logs or backups will be exported off-region." Will finalize after infra DM.

Mina (Sales): Pricing (internal ballpark): one-time setup $650 (routing + sink + config), BYOK import $140 one-time, key mgmt surcharge $75/month per region (pro-rated), regional index worker (optional) $100 for POC. Total ~ $965 without HSM extras. Note HSM import may add cost/time.

Client_Lumen: OK please send the formal quote + attestation text. We'll provide BYOK material and bucket ARN today.

compliance-bot: Compliance bundle (SOC2/ISO) shared: https://redwood.internal/compliance/poc-bundle-2487654321 (access: redwood staff + vendor token)

Alejandra (Infra): Action items: post full sub-processor list to @tara by EOD, confirm HSM lead time, schedule tenant pin once BYOK + bucket are provided.

Mina (Sales): I'll assemble the quote and onboarding steps. Targeting Mon kickoff pending approvals. :thumbsup:
